components.name: Circular column bay
components.function: Need circular column/plinth/ring-beam hosts, dome-to-drum seat and radial stair/courtyard joins. Existing source already supplies dome stars, acanthus capitals, urns and mosaic patterns; do not substitute Gothic palace capitals. Cypress/cream flowerbeds; restrained birds/pollinators. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated circular column bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
